text_en: She reaches mightily from one end of the earth to the other, and she orders all things well.
text_cn: 智慧施展威力，从地极直达地极，从容治理万物。

text_en: I loved her and sought her from my youth; I desired to take her for my bride, and became enamored of her beauty.
text_cn: 我爱慕智慧，自幼就寻求她，设法娶她作我的配偶：我实在喜爱她的美丽，

text_en: She glorifies her noble birth by living with God, and the Lord of all loves her.
text_cn: 因她与天主共同生活，更彰显了她出身的尊贵；万有的主宰也喜爱她。

text_en: For she is an initiate in the knowledge of God, and an associate in his works.
text_cn: 她实在透彻天主的奥秘，自行决择天主的工程。

text_en: If riches are a desirable possession in life, what is richer than wisdom, the active cause of all things?
text_cn: 如果财富是今生所极贪求的对象，有什么比创造一切的智慧更为富足？

text_en: And if understanding is effective, who more than she is fashioner of what exists?
text_cn: 如果理智指导工作，那么，在万有中有谁比智慧更配作技师？

text_en: And if anyone loves righteousness, her labors are virtues; for she teaches self-control and prudence, justice and courage; nothing in life is more profitable for mortals than these.
text_cn: 若有人爱慕正义，应知道：德行是智慧工作的效果，因为她教训人节制、明智、公义和勇敢：在此生没有比这些为人更有裨（bì）益。

text_en: And if anyone longs for wide experience, she knows the things of old, and infers the things to come; she understands turns of speech and the solutions of riddles; she has foreknowledge of signs and wonders and of the outcome of seasons and times.
text_cn: 若有人希望有丰富的经验，智慧知道往古，推测未来，通晓深言奥意，会解释谜语，预知异迹和奇事，年代和世纪的结局。

text_en: Therefore I determined to take her to live with me, knowing that she would give me good counsel and encouragement in cares and grief.
text_cn: 为此，我决意娶她与我一同生活，深知她是我顺境中的参谋，是我忧虑与困苦中的安慰。

text_en: Because of her I shall have glory among the multitudes and honor in the presence of the elders, though I am young.
text_cn: 我虽然年幼，藉着她，我在民众中必获荣耀，必为长老所尊重；

text_en: I shall be found keen in judgment, and in the sight of rulers I shall be admired.
text_cn: 我在断案时，必断狱机敏，有权势的人见了，都对我表示钦佩。【长官见了，莫不对我惊奇。】

text_en: When I am silent they will wait for me, and when I speak they will give heed; if I speak at greater length, they will put their hands on their mouths.
text_cn: 我沉默，他们就静候；我发言，他们就侧耳静听；我若讲论不绝，他们就用手掩住自己的口。

text_en: Because of her I shall have immortality, and leave an everlasting remembrance to those who come after me.
text_cn: 藉着她，我将永垂不朽，且为我以后的人，留下永恒的记念。

text_en: I shall govern peoples, and nations will be subject to me;
text_cn: 我要统治万民，列邦都要归顺我。

text_en: dread monarchs will be afraid of me when they hear of me; among the people I shall show myself capable, and courageous in war.
text_cn: 可畏的君侯听见我必要恐惧；在民众前，我将显示温良；在战争时，我将显出勇敢。

text_en: When I enter my house, I shall find rest with her; for companionship with her has no bitterness, and life with her has no pain, but gladness and joy.
text_cn: 回到家中，只有在她身旁，我才获得安息；因为只要与她为伴，便没有苦恼；与她共同生活，便没有悲哀，只有喜乐和愉快。

text_en: When I considered these things inwardly, and pondered in my heart that in kinship with wisdom there is immortality,
text_cn: 我每一念及这些思想，心里反复思量：不死不灭是在于与智慧亲近，

text_en: and in friendship with her, pure delight, and in the labors of her hands, unfailing wealth, and in the experience of her company, understanding, and renown in sharing her words, I went about seeking how to get her for myself.
text_cn: 纯洁的喜乐是在于与智慧为友，无尽的财富是在于智慧手中的工作；明哲是在于与智慧结交，声誉是在于与智慧交谈；因此，我寻遍方法，好能将她娶到手中。

text_en: As a child I was naturally gifted, and a good soul fell to my lot;
text_cn: 我原是个性善的孩子，获得了个善良的灵魂；

text_en: or rather, being good, I entered an undefiled body.
text_cn: 或更好说，因为我善良，我进入了一个无玷的身体内；

text_en: But I perceived that I would not possess wisdom unless God gave her to me— and it was a mark of insight to know whose gift she was— so I appealed to the Lord and implored him, and with my whole heart I said:
text_cn: 但我知道，天主若不将她赐给我，我不会获得她──连知道这是谁的恩赐，已经是由于智慧──我于是转向上主全心祈求他说：
